title.narrative: Decentralization and Local Government Strengthening II
Descentralizacin y Fortalecimiento del Gobierno Municipal II

description.narrative: Continuar apoyando a los gobiernos locales de Suriname a los esfuerzos de descentralizacin que se empezaron desde 2001. Particularmente, apoyar a gobiernos locales de Paramaribo, Sipalliwini, Saramacca, Coronie, y Brokopondo, de manera que obtengan una marco legal base y una relevante capacidad institucional para auto administrarse. Inclusive, la DLGS-II tambin asistir a distritos certificados de Wanica, Para, Nickerie, Commewijne, y Marowijne en la implementacin de servicios locales y proyectos de inversin de infraestructura.

To continue supporting Suriname's local government's decentralization efforts that commenced back in 2001. Specially, assisting local governments in Paramaribo, Sipaliwini, Saramacca, Coronie, and Brokopondo attain a core legal framework and relevant institutional capacity for fiscal self-management. Furthermore, the DLGS-II will also assist certified districts of Wanica, Para, Nickerie, Commewijne, and Marowijne in the implementation of local services and infrastructure investment projects.
